# Close-out report template (one page per Drop)

Publish for **every** Drop, including ones that were delayed, partly funded or cancelled. Facts only; no unverified numbers. Keep supporting documents privately and publish summaries.

**Drop:** [TITLE] · **Appeal ID:** [DROP-NNN] · **Closed:** [DATE] · **Report author / approver:** [ROLE]

## 1. Outcome in one paragraph
[What was planned, what happened, whether the aim was met, fully or partly.]

## 2. Money
| | £ | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Raised (donations received) | | Source: [payment provider report, period] |
| Gift Aid claimed / expected | | Stated separately; say whether received |
| Operating support (15%) | | Calculated on [basis] |
| Drop fund | | |
| Sent to partner | | Dates and tranches |
| Spent by partner (per receipts) | | |
| Unspent / returned / reallocated | | What was done and under which donor-facing rule |
Reconciliation: [Who reconciled, date, any difference and why.]

## 3. What was delivered
| Item | Planned | Delivered | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Item] | [ ] | [ ] | |
People reached: **[conservative figure, with how it was counted by the partner]**

## 4. Evidence
[Receipt summary; partner sign-off date; photos or video only where safe, consented and appropriate; anything that could not be shared and why.]

## 5. What went wrong or changed
[Delays, price changes, substitutions, access problems, incidents, complaints. If none, say "None reported" and who confirmed that.]

## 6. Lessons and changes
[Two to five honest points and what RallyGood will do differently.]

## 7. Thank you and next
[Short, factual. Link to the next Drop if there is one.]

## Publication checklist
- [ ] Numbers reconcile to bank/payment records
- [ ] Partner reviewed the draft for accuracy and safety
- [ ] No personal data, exact vulnerable locations or identifying images without consent
- [ ] Added to the Drops archive on `/transparency.html`
- [ ] Donors notified
